definition.description: Retrieves the partner's invoices from Microsoft Partner Center API. Returns a list of invoices with billing periods, charges, currency, and line item details.

inputFields.helpText: Bearer token for Partner Center API authentication. Typically obtained from an OAuth node.

outputParameters.description: Total number of invoices returned by the API
Number of invoices in the items array
JSON array of all invoice objects
ID of the most recent invoice
Date of the most recent invoice
Billing period start date of the most recent invoice
Billing period end date of the most recent invoice
Total charges on the most recent invoice
Amount paid on the most recent invoice
Currency code of the most recent invoice (e.g., SEK)
Currency symbol of the most recent invoice (e.g., kr)
PDF download link for the most recent invoice
Type of the most recent invoice (e.g., Recurring)
Document type of the most recent invoice
JSON array of billing providers on the most recent invoice (e.g., office, azure)
Sum of total charges across all invoices
Sum of paid amounts across all invoices
Total outstanding amount (charges - paid) across all invoices
The full raw JSON response body
HTTP status code from the API response
True if an error occurred during the request
Error details if the request failed

connectionTags.description: Triggered when invoices were successfully retrieved
Triggered when the request fails or returns an error status
